written: 2026-11-14, after the single run on test (9fbe014) and after the post-test dev runs; before any test2 run
purpose: Confirm, on fresh questions, hypotheses formed after looking at test. test2 is NOT used to change results/selection.json.

hypotheses.H1_budget: Retrieval-only: Context Evidence of hybrid_rerank_B at 8000 chars >= at 4000 chars (budget_ablation). Agent: agent_hrr_B_ctx8k has Context Evidence >= agent_hrr_B and no more false abstentions.
hypotheses.H2_multisearch: On the 2 multi-hop questions (a09, a10), agent_hrr_B (up to 4 searches) has no more false abstentions than agent_hrr_B_1shot.
hypotheses.H3_replication: Selected agent_hrr_B_1shot vs baseline agent_dense_B: grounded mean difference reported as is (test showed a tie, 1.82 vs 1.82).

decision_rule: Each hypothesis is reported as supported / not supported / inconclusive (difference <= 1 question). With 10 answerable questions, one question = 0.2 points of grounded mean; no claim of statistical significance.
grading: Same 0/1/2 scale and citation/abstention rules as dev/test; every trace read; exceptions with hand-written reasons in results/agent/test2/labels/grading_spec_test2.json.
